spec.title: Throughput - blocks/s
spec.description: Rate of blocks ordered and output to the read path.

spec.title: Throughput - batches/s
spec.description: Rate of batches (proofs of availability) ordered and output to the read path.

spec.title: Availability Store Cache Statistics
spec.description: Summary of cache hits, misses, and evictions for the Availability store's batch data cache

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (irate(daml_cache_hits{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node", cache="batch-cache"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (namespace, job, node) (irate(daml_cache_misses{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node", cache="batch-cache"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (namespace, job, node) (irate(daml_cache_evictions{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node", cache="batch-cache"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Epoch Transfer Duration
spec.description: Time to transfer a given epoch from peer(s)

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by(namespace, job, node, Leader) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_consensus_view_change_progress_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by(namespace, job, node, Leader) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_consensus_relative_segment_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Segment Flush Block Rate
spec.description: Rate of empty blocks created due to segment flushing, in which a node detects that a strong quorum of peers have already finished their segment, and thus the local segment should be rushed (flushed) to completion to reduce ordering and delivery delays.

spec.title: Number of batches that need to be fetched
spec.description: Batches that have been ordered, but aren't available locally so need to be fetched from other peers.

spec.title: Output Fetch Latency
spec.description: The time from first output fetch request until we get a response.

spec.title: Output Fetch Timeouts
spec.description: The rate of batch fetch timeouts per fetch request recipient

spec.title: P2P gRPC not ready duration
spec.description: How long gRPC reports the sender as not ready

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, target_sequencer) (irate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_send_grpc_flow_control_not_ready_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: gRPC send drop rate
spec.description: The rate of gRPC message send drops

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, target_sequencer, send_failure_reason) (irate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_send_sends_dropped{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Output block interleaving wait — quantile (per leader and total)
spec.description: For each block extracted from the output Peano queue, the time it waited for lower-numbered blocks ("holes") that delayed its extraction. The total line is a true per-block quantile (selected by $percentile) of each block's total interleaving wait, recorded once for every extracted block (including a zero for in-order blocks that never waited), so it covers the same per-block population as the output-stage duration panel and is directly comparable to it, showing how much of that latency is due to ISS segment interleaving. The per-leader series are the same quantile of the individual per-block contributions attributed to the assigned segment leader responsible for each delaying hole; because quantiles are not additive they do not sum to the total line, but they show the typical delay contributed by each leader/segment. See the companion average panel below for an additive per-leader/total breakdown.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, leader) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-block-interleaving-wait"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Output stage duration (average)
spec.description: Mean per-block output stage duration (total accrued duration divided by the number of blocks emitted). Companion to the quantile panel above; the mean is additive, so it is directly comparable to the per-leader interleaving-wait averages.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_sum(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-stage-duration"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_count(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-stage-duration"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Output block interleaving wait — average (per leader and total)
spec.description: Mean per-block interleaving wait: total accrued wait-seconds divided by the number of blocks emitted (the output-stage-duration block rate). Unlike the quantile panel, means are additive, so the per-leader series sum exactly to the total line and break the average interleaving wait down by the assigned segment leader responsible for each delaying hole. The total line is derived from the same per-leader output-block-interleaving-wait series (summed over all leaders), so it works on historical data without the output-block-interleaving-total-wait stage that only the quantile panel requires. Compare the total line with the output-stage-duration average panel to see the mean share of output-stage latency due to ISS segment interleaving.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, leader) (histogram_sum(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-block-interleaving-wait"}[$__rate_interval]))) / on (namespace, job, node) group_left sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_count(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-stage-duration"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_sum(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-block-interleaving-wait"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_count(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-stage-duration"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Consensus first segment block ordering latency (per leader)
spec.description: Time elapsed between the start of an epoch's segments and the ordering of the first block (relative block number 0) of each segment, attributed to the original leader of the segment

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, leader) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"consensus-first-segment-block-order-latency"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: P2P gRPC network latency
spec.description: Latency between sending a message and receiving it on the other side

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, source_sequencer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_send_grpc_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: TCP window scale (per peer)
spec.description: TCP send and receive window scaling factors for the P2P connection to each peer (requires the Netty epoll transport).

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_tcp_send_window_scale{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"})
max by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_tcp_receive_window_scale{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"})

spec.title: TCP wire-level bytes (per peer)
spec.description: Rate of raw TCP wire-level bytes (including TLS and framing overhead) sent and received per peer.

spec.title: TCP retransmitted segments (current, per peer)
spec.description: Current number of outstanding (unacknowledged) retransmitted TCP segments on the P2P connection to each peer, sampled from tcpi_retrans (requires the Netty epoll transport). This is an instantaneous value, not a cumulative count.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_tcp_retransmitted_segments{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"})

spec.title: TCP round-trip time (per peer)
spec.description: TCP-level smoothed round-trip time to each peer (requires the Netty epoll transport).

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_tcp_rtt_micros{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"})

spec.title: P2P stream teardowns (per peer)
spec.description: Rate of P2P gRPC stream teardowns observed as errors, per peer, connection direction and gRPC status code. This is a gRPC/networking-level signal (always emitted, independent of whether transport metrics are enabled), useful to diagnose remote- or infrastructure-initiated resets (e.g. a proxy GOAWAY/RST_STREAM surfaced as UNAVAILABLE).

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction, grpc_status) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_stream_teardowns{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[1m]))

spec.title: Application-level round-trip time (per peer)
spec.description: Distribution ($percentile quantile) of the application-level round-trip time to each peer, measured by periodically sending a low-frequency `ConnectionOpened` echo probe that the peer reflects back. Unlike the TCP-level RTT, this is connection-direction- and transport-independent, so it is always available, but it also includes application-level queuing and processing time.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, peer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_stream_round_trip_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Requests end-to-end ordering latency
spec.description: Wall-clock duration between the instant a request is received by the CantonBFT orderer and the instant the fully assembled ordered block metadata is stored, just before the request is pushed to the post-ordering stages. Its meaningfulness requires wall-clock synchronization, as not all ordered requests are received and timestamped on this node.

spec.title: gRPC send retry rate
spec.description: The rate of gRPC message send retries

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, target_sequencer, send_failure_reason) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_send_sends_retried{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Total batch dissemination and consensus time (permanence in availability module)

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, ordering_stage) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"batch-availability-total"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: P2P gRPC sent message size (per peer)
spec.description: Distribution ($percentile quantile) of serialized gRPC message sizes sent to each peer.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, target_sequencer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_send_sent_message_size{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: P2P gRPC received message size (per peer)
spec.description: Distribution ($percentile quantile) of serialized gRPC message sizes received from each peer.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by (namespace, job, node, source_sequencer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_receive_received_message_size{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: P2P gRPC average message size (per peer)
spec.description: Average serialized gRPC message size, sent to and received from each peer.

spec.expr: histogram_sum(sum by (namespace, job, node, target_sequencer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_send_sent_message_size{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) / histogram_count(sum by (namespace, job, node, target_sequencer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_send_sent_message_size{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_sum(sum by (namespace, job, node, source_sequencer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_receive_received_message_size{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) / histogram_count(sum by (namespace, job, node, source_sequencer) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_receive_received_message_size{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: HTTP/2 active concurrent streams (per peer)
spec.description: Number of concurrently active HTTP/2 streams on the P2P connection to each peer.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_http2_active_streams{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"})

spec.title: HTTP/2 stream open/close rate (per peer)
spec.description: Rate at which HTTP/2 streams are opened and closed on the P2P connection to each peer.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_http2_streams_opened_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[1m]))
sum by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_http2_streams_closed_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[1m]))

spec.title: gRPC messages sent/received (per peer)
spec.description: Rate of gRPC messages sent and received per peer on the P2P connection (from Channelz message counts). Note that a single gRPC message may span multiple HTTP/2 DATA frames, so this is not a raw frame count.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_grpc_messages_sent_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[1m]))
sum by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_grpc_messages_received_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[1m]))

spec.title: HTTP/2 keepalive pings (per peer)
spec.description: Rate of HTTP/2 keepalive PING frames sent on the P2P connection to each peer.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_http2_keepalive_pings{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[1m]))

spec.title: HTTP/2 flow control window (bytes, per peer)
spec.description: Local and remote HTTP/2 flow control window sizes for the P2P connection to each peer.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_http2_flow_control_local_window_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"})
max by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_http2_flow_control_remote_window_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"})

spec.title: HTTP/2 flow control stalls (per peer)
spec.description: Rate of samples where the HTTP/2 flow control window to a peer was observed exhausted.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node, peer, direction) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_p2p_transport_http2_flow_control_stalls_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[1m]))

spec.title: Total dissemination time
spec.description: Cumulative latency of a batch dissemination until a PoA is formed and it can be present multiple times for a given batch if it regresses due to topology changes

spec.title: Time waited for batch inclusion in consensus proposal
spec.description: Insertion in proposal queue until next event, like re-sign, re-dissemination, [re-]proposal or batch ordered (emitted 1 or more times per batch)

spec.title: Time spent waiting for batches
spec.description: Time waited for a batch while there are outstanding consensus proposal requests and no dissemination is in progress

spec.title: Compute pruning point
spec.description: Time to compute the pruning point, based on retention factors and current time

spec.title: Availability DB - evict expired batches
spec.description: Time to evict unordered, but expired, batches in the availability DB

spec.title: Batch dissemination regressions rate
spec.description: Rate of regressions of a single batch due to topology changes

spec.title: Save blacklist leader selection policy state
Block inspection
spec.description: Time needed to inspect requests within a block

spec.title: Consensus Block Latency
spec.description: Block commit time at the consensus (PBFT) level.

spec.title: Retransmission responses discarded due to wrong epoch - rate
Retransmission requests discarded due to rate limiting - rate
Consensus segment block proposal to commit latency
spec.description: Time elapsed between sending a PrePrepare and seeing that the block has been ordered

spec.title: Create partitions
spec.description: Time to create new table partitions, when necessary

spec.title: Prune (Delete partitions)
spec.description: Time to drop table partitions that can be pruned

spec.title: Partition manager startup
spec.description: Time to start the Partition Manager, which may include creating new partitions

spec.title: Wait for epoch completion
spec.description: Time between the last led segment's completion and the epoch completion

spec.title: Wait for epoch start
spec.description: Time between the epoch completion and the start of the next epoch

spec.title: Wait for proposal
spec.description: Time between a proposal request to the availability module needed to continue a segment and a PrePrepare being built

spec.title: Consensus segment block ordering latency
spec.description: Time elapsed between ordered blocks proposed by a segment

spec.title: Request batch inclusion latency
spec.description: Insertion in batch queue until extraction and batch send to availability

spec.title: Postponed view messages queue max size
Postponed consensus messages queue max size
